expectation: Membrane rings on a distinct subset of small lymphocytes (CD8 T cells). Expected as scattered single cells in lamina propria/stroma, intraepithelial cells along the epithelium, and denser groups in lymphoid aggregates within CD3 areas. Dimmer on some NK/DC cells.
observed: A: gut-like sections with fine punctate yellow, some edge glow and background haze. B: scattered discrete ring-shaped cells. C: cells strung along a gland's epithelium, like intraepithelial lymphocytes. D: blurred bright cells. E1: many crisp rings; E3: many white (CD8+CD3+) cells.
why: Discrete membrane-ringed cells sit in the expected places (stroma, intraepithelial along a gland, a CD3-dense aggregate), and in E they overlap CD3E as a subset.
notes: B and C show crisp CD8a membrane rings on scattered stromal and intraepithelial lymphocytes. In row E the CD8a cells sit on CD3E+ cells, many showing white. The haze and edge glow in A are background and do not drive the verdict.
